slides.title: Two governments, two letters to the UN

slides.body: Ethiopia told the UN Security Council Eritrean troops had advanced up to 60 km into Tigray. Eritrea rejects the claim.

slides.title: Eritrea calls it a pretext
slides.body: Eritrea says the accusations are a pretext for an Addis Ababa offensive and asked the Council to act.

slides.title: Fighting is moving north
slides.body: Al Jazeera reported Ethiopian troops and allied militias entered Adigrat, about 30 km from the Eritrean border.

slides.title: Claims are hard to verify
slides.body: Al Jazeera could not verify a Tigray Peace Force commander's account of Eritrean entry into Adigrat.

slides.title: Protect civilians. Allow independent monitoring. Choose dialogue.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

source: Source: Al Jazeera, "Ethiopia, Eritrea ramp up rhetoric" · Oct 11, 2026

card.title: Claimed advance into Tigray
card.body: Ethiopia told the UN; Eritrea rejects it, reports Al Jazeera.
